They played their home games at the [[Moody Center]] in [[Austin, Texas]], as second-year members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. The Longhorns were led by first-year head coach [[Sean Miller]]. ==Previous season== The [[2024–25 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Longhorns]] finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2024–25 season]] 19–16, 6–12 in [[2024–25 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for 13th place. As the No. 13 seed in the [[2025 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]], they defeated [[2024–25 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] and [[2024–25 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]] before losing to [[2024–25 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2025 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 11 seed in the Midwest region. There, they lost to [[2024–25 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the First Four.
